rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a usable day-5 blastocyst and notes ICM/TE quality, but it questions visible hatching despite the provided Gardner 4AB and includes some uncertain image-based claims.
Integrates age, AMH, prior ectopic, endometrium, sperm, BMI, and cohort size with embryo quality and prognosis, though some interactions could be more tightly linked.
Overall logical, but there are internal inconsistencies in probability framing and some mixed statements about morphology versus grade and prognosis.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, ectopic surveillance, cavity/tubal review, and selective discussion of PGT-A; minor deviations include speculative comments and less precise guideline framing.
Provides practical next steps including SET, serial beta-hCG, early ultrasound, hydrosalpinx/cavity evaluation, and future-cycle considerations, though not highly detailed on protocol adjustments.
